decisions.why: Division name indicates multiple product types: beds and stretchers (handling:bed) plus specialist seating/chairs (rehab:chair)—Eleganza models, early mobilization benefit categories.
Hospital beds and stretchers with mobility features—Early Mobilization Mcx, Easy Patient Transportation Mcx, Falls Prevention Mcx.
Pressure injury prevention and comfort—Hospital Operations Efficiency A2C, Pressure Injury Prevention A2C, Prevention of Hospital Acquired Infections A2C.
Clinical furniture—Eleganza Classic, Eleganza Mano, Solido models indicate hospital examination and clinical furniture.
